business_problem: Cemex wanted to improve how its salesforce supports customers in real time, so teams could answer project-specific questions with accurate product and construction-regulation knowledge and deliver a better customer experience.
solution_summary: Cemex built a generative AI sales knowledge assistant as part of its Digital Forward program, using Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service as the core AI engine and Microsoft Teams as the delivery channel. The assistant was trained on Cemex product information and the company’s expertise in construction regulations, with an underlying data management system organizing that knowledge so the model can return tailored guidance for different project requirements. In operation, sales staff access the assistant through Teams from internet-enabled devices, submit customer or project questions, and receive real-time responses about product fit, expected behaviors, and needs. Azure OpenAI Service provides the scalable inference layer, while Teams handles workforce access and deployment. Cemex says the design is intended to be replicated across its global operations, turning internal product and regulatory knowledge into a sales-facing copilot for more consistent customer interactions.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI capability that powers Cemex's sales knowledge assistant and generates real-time answers from company knowledge.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Serves as the access channel through which Cemex deploys the assistant to sales staff on internet-enabled devices.

data_flow: Cemex product information and construction-regulation expertise are organized in a data management system and used to ground a knowledge assistant built on Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service. Sales staff access the assistant in Microsoft Teams, where prompts are turned into real-time answers tailored to customer project requirements and then delivered back to users on connected devices.
business_outcome: The assistant gives Cemex sales teams real-time support, helps tailor solutions to project requirements, improves customer interactions, and is designed for replication across Cemex's global operations.
